description: Returns one presentation: title, settings, questions (with correct answers unless `include_answers` is false), the live session if one is running (PIN, participants), and the most recent sessions. Useful for editing an existing presentation (get, modify, then `sparka_presentation_save` with the same `presentation_id`) or for checking what a deck is using.
name: sparka_presentation_get

accent_color.description: Join-page accent for buttons and the timer bar; never answer tiles.

leaderboard_size.description: Leaderboard rows shown on reveal of a scored question. 0 = no leaderboard.

phone_display.description: full: phones show the question text and options (best for hybrid/remote). answers_only: phones show only answer tiles (letter + shape + color); the room reads the question on the big screen.

show_rank_on_phone.description: After reveal, each phone sees its own points and rank.

items.description: Owner copy; includes correct answers unless include_answers is false.

title: Get a presentation
